journal.celestial.finale:
The light has returned.

The sky shines again, and Heaven is open to all who dare to rise.

Thank you, Wanderer.

§o— Celestial§r
journal.celestial.flame: The Flame is yours. It is warm but does not burn, as if it remembers the sky.
journal.celestial.gates:
Heaven! Islands float above the clouds and gravity is gentle here. Mind the edge: fall off and you will find yourself high above the Overworld.

The wisps will guide you to the shrines.
journal.celestial.intro:
Wanderer,

if you are reading this, the light of the heavens is fading. Nights grow longer and stars fall one by one.

Three shards held the light: Flame, Void and Light. They were scattered across three worlds.
journal.celestial.seraph: The Seraph has fallen. His wings and halo are yours now, and so is the Light Shard.
journal.celestial.task_altar:
§lThe last step§r

The Celestial Altar stands in the Citadel. Place all three shards upon it.
journal.celestial.task_flame:
§lThe first shard§r

The Flame Shard hides in the depths of the Nether: search the chests of Nether fortresses and bastions. Blazes are said to carry them too.
journal.celestial.task_gates:
§lThe Gates§r

Radiant Stone is forged from glowstone dust, Nether quartz and gold. Build a frame of it (like a Nether portal) and touch it with the Void Heart.
journal.celestial.task_seraph:
§lThe third shard§r

The Light Shard was stolen by the Fallen Seraph. He sleeps sealed in the Celestial Citadel. Prepare well: etherite armor, a starbow and plenty of manna.
journal.celestial.task_void:
§lThe second shard§r

The Void Heart beats inside the Ender Dragon. Defeat it and the Heart will fall at your feet. It has also been found in End city chests.
journal.celestial.void: The Void Heart pulses in your hand. It opens what is closed to mortals.
puzzle.celestial.bells.already: The bells already sing in unison
puzzle.celestial.bells.listen: Listen to the melody and repeat it on the bells
puzzle.celestial.riddle.0: §6The runes read: §fI fall but never break. I fly but have no wings. What am I?
puzzle.celestial.riddle.1: §6The runes read: §fSofter than down, whiter than snow, it holds those who walk the sky.
puzzle.celestial.riddle.2: §6The runes read: §fWithout legs I walk, without hands I point, without eyes I know the night.
puzzle.celestial.riddle.3: §6The runes read: §fBorn in the darkness of the Nether, yet I carry light.
puzzle.celestial.riddle.4: §6The runes read: §fFood that falls from the sky.
puzzle.celestial.riddle.5: §6The runes read: §fI always look one way, wherever you go.
puzzle.celestial.riddle.6: §6The runes read: §fI am the voice of the deep that repeats after you.
puzzle.celestial.riddle.7: §6The runes read: §fFell from the sky, but not rain. Shines, but not fire.
puzzle.celestial.riddle.solved: §aThe riddle is solved - the runes glow calmly.
story.celestial.dream: §eYou dream of a darkening sky and a voice asking for help. When you wake, an old journal is in your bag.
story.celestial.epilogue.1: §e✦ The shards merge into a pillar of light that pierces the clouds.
story.celestial.epilogue.2: §e✦ Stars light up above the Overworld again.
story.celestial.epilogue.3: §e✦ The angels step out of their homes and sing for the first time in years.
story.celestial.epilogue.4: §e✦ The Blessing of the heavens is upon you: +2 hearts, forever.
story.celestial.epilogue.5: §7The End. Heaven remains open - keep exploring.
story.celestial.finale.subtitle: The heavens shine again
story.celestial.finale.title: §6The Light Returns
story.celestial.portal_lit: §6The frame flares with golden light. The Gates of Heaven are open!
story.celestial.seraph_defeated: §6The Seraph dissolves into light. The Light Shard is free! Bring all three shards to the Citadel altar.
story.celestial.void_heart_drop: §5A pulsing Void Heart falls from the dragon...
